verdict.rationale: GitLab documents built-in AI agents (GitLab Duo) that can convert issues into merge requests, remediate vulnerabilities, and review code while teams retain oversight, directly matching task delegation to an in-product AI assistant. However, this is vendor marketing language only, with no independent/hands-on corroboration of how well the delegation works in practice. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on validation of agent task delegation, detail on scope/limits of what can be delegated, and community feedback on reliability of the AI assistant itself.
